add.title: A walk into a referenced child stamps the child's own lines with the writer, not "owner"
add.why: mastermind-page wrote {tasks:{core-page-parts-part-view-and-part-file:{wait:{...}}}} into core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/task.jsonl at 03:14:22Z (by mastermind-page); the child's own log part-types/session.jsonl then got five set lines (state, waiting_on, waiting_what, waiting_since, ran_ms) stamped by "owner" at 03:14:23Z. A reader of that log would think the owner set the wait. Find where a referenced child's Store stamps by (core/Item Store or the item tool's child write) and pass the parent line's by down.

add.title: Item page check 'hydrate survives non-object data and a non-array items value' fails
add.why: Fails on michael/dev and on worktree/class-docs alike (seen 2026-10-28 by build C, headless): Item.hydrate({data: 5, items: 'nope'}) no longer leaves h.items undefined or h.data empty. Item.js is build A's; either the check or hydrate is out of date.
